'''Jowar''' was one of the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] who helped develop the [[nanovirus]] at the end of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]], Jowar served on [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal staff as a young officer in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
